title: The Heretic's Child
text: A child of the Court catches at your sleeve in a dark alley, a little girl with a prayer bead hidden in her fist. Her parents are apostates, she whispers. She still prays to the Six, in secret, and if they find out, they will burn her. She begs you to take her away.

outcomes.text: She clings to your hand, and the Court sends its hunters after you.

options.label: The shrewdest hides her among the pilgrims.

outcomes.text: She gets away, and no one ever knows how.

options.label: Refuse her. It is not your place.

outcomes.text: She watches you go, the bead in her fist. You will think of her when you smell smoke.
